tpms.when: 2024 with the Apps menu screen (the manual gives this reset for tires with special approval)
steps: Set all four tires to the cold pressure on the label in the driver's door opening.
Open the Apps menu, then Vehicle apps, then Vehicle status, then Tire Pressure Monitor.
Make sure the tire settings shown there match the tires on the car.
Switch the car to drive-ready but stay parked.
Drive off. The wheels show gray while the reset runs and it finishes on its own after several minutes of driving. Green wheels and a reset-successful message mean it is done.
tpms.note: If you stop partway, the reset carries on when you drive again. If the wheels stay gray, the system may have a fault and should be checked. If the tire pressure light flashes for about a minute when you start the car and then stays on, the warning system itself has a fault. A reset won't fix it; have it checked.

notes: Only the 2024 owner's manual was checked for this model.
